title: History
subtitle: See how up to four sensors changed over time: minimum, average, maximum and the latest value.

chips.label: Selected sensors
chips.missing: This sensor is not in the catalog any more. Stored history may still exist.
chips.notNumeric: Only numeric sensors can be charted.

stats.noData: No data in this range yet

chart.emptyBody: Recording starts when a sensor is used on a dial or opened here. The chart fills in as data arrives: every second in the 15-minute view, once a minute for longer ranges.
chart.errorBody: VU Studio did not return any data. It will try again shortly.

empty.title: Pick a sensor to see its history
empty.body: VU Studio records history for the sensors you use on your dials and for the ones you open here. Recording starts the first time you add a sensor.

footnote: Longer ranges show one point per minute, grouped when there are many; the shaded band is the minimum to maximum of each group and the line is the average.
